Alex (Finance): FYI — noticed a ~48% increase in cloud GPU spend on the April invoice for us-west. Tag breakdown shows 60% of the spike attributed to project=search-reindex but our cost center shows that as platform not product. Anyone see stray workloads? :eyes:

Priya (Billing Ops): @Alex can you paste the invoice id / cost export link? I can pull the BQ export and reconcile. Did you mean April 8–15 window? We had a few autoscale tests then.

Alex (Finance): Invoice: INV-2025-04-09, export link: https://console.cloud.google/.../billing/exports/abc123 (internal). My initial peek via cost-aggregation pivot shows 'unlabeled' GPU hours: 1,220h.

Sam (Eng Infra): Sorry — we ramped a large in-house model benchmark for latency on 2025-04-09. Ran a cluster with preemptible+non-preemptible mix. I thought billing tags would propagate but we missed `cost_center` tag on one deploy. :sweat_smile:

Marta (Data Platform): Confirmed — in resource_labels table the VM instances for reindex job don't have `cost_center` or `team` labels, only `job_id`. That's why export grouped them under 'unknown'.

Priya (Billing Ops): Ok. Two things: 1) We can retro-attribute using labels via the billing export join (if we have instance IDs/tags in logs). 2) We need a one-time journal entry for April to move spend to ENG-ML dept. I'll prepare a reconciliation file. Who owns the reindex job to provide job_id -> team mapping?

Sam (Eng Infra): That's me. Job_id=search-reindex-20250409. You can map to team=search-product, cost_center=ENG-SEARCH.

Priya (Billing Ops): Great. I'll run a BigQuery job to split costs. Sample query I'll use:

```sql
-- attribute GPU cost to instances with matching job_id
SELECT
  COALESCE(labels.cost_center, 'unknown') AS cost_center,
  SUM(gpu_cost) AS gpu_cost
FROM
  `billing.gcp_export_v1` b
LEFT JOIN
  `production.vm_metadata` m
ON b.resource_id = m.instance_id
WHERE DATE(_PARTITIONTIME) BETWEEN '2025-04-08' AND '2025-04-15'
  AND b.product = 'Compute Engine'
GROUP BY cost_center;
```

Priya (Billing Ops): I'll put the CSV in /shared/billing/reconciliations/2025-04-gpu.csv and tag @Finance for approval on the journal entry.

Alex (Finance): Please add a note for the GL codes: 6100-Cloud Compute (debit) / 2100-Accrued Dev Costs (credit). We'll need manager sign-off for >$10k reallocations.

Sam (Eng Infra): I'll update infra automation to enforce labels on all GPU instance templates — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/781 :thumbsup:

Marta (Data Platform): Also setting a BigQuery scheduled query to alert on unlabeled GPU spend > $500/day. I'll add a Slack alert to #eng-infra and #finance-alerts.

BillingBot: Budget alert: project=platform-gpu budget 'GPU Platform' breached 75% on 2025-04-10 03:12 UTC — triggered notify -> #finance-alerts

Priya (Billing Ops): Action items:
- Priya: run reconciliation + CSV, create journal draft
- Alex: approve journal and GL mapping
- Sam: patch infra to enforce labels + retro metadata export
- Marta: create alert + scheduled query

Alex (Finance): Thanks team. Can we aim to close this by EOD Friday (2025-04-18)? Tag me when journal draft is ready. :calendar:

Sam (Eng Infra): Will do. Putting a sticky note on the reindex runbook to remind labeling.

Marta (Data Platform): I'll also backfill labels where possible using GCE instance metadata and stackdriver logs.

Priya (Billing Ops): Uploading CSV now.

Alex (Finance): Received. I'll review and route for sign-off.
